gui.bondofthebeast.staff.title: Pet Control
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.info.tooltip:
§6Grimoire of Domination

§eBond and Levels:
§fKeep the pet close (within 16 blocks). The bond deepens every minute.

§eReward:
§fA high level unlocks more complex commands.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.sp_tooltip:
Bond Points: %s

Earned upon reaching a new bond level.
Used to unlock new directives.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.sit.name: Stay
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.tp.name: Heel
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.tp.desc: Automatically recalls the pet if it falls more than 20 blocks behind.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.prot.name: Blood Guard
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.prot.desc: The pet goes into a frenzy, tracking only your target through walls.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.aura.name: Aura Merge
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.aura.desc: Slowly drains the pet's life energy to heal you.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.pacifist.name: Pacifism
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.pacifist.desc: Forbids the pet from attacking any creatures.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.vampiric.name: Vampirism
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.nobreak.name: Soft Paws
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.nobreak.desc: Forbids the pet from breaking any blocks.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.absorb.name: Absorption
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.absorb.desc: Seals the pet inside the Grimoire (max 5 blocks). The pet loses its body and sees through your eyes.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.blacklist.name: Blacklist
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.blacklist.desc: Blocks the pet is forbidden to break.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.whitelist.name: Whitelist
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.whitelist.desc: Blocks the pet is always allowed to break.
gui.bondofthebeast.pet_diary.title: Diary of a Pet
gui.bondofthebeast.pet_diary.info.toolti:
§6Your bond with the Master

§eObedience:
§fThe longer you stay near the Master, the stronger your bond becomes.

§eYour role:
§fYou are a loyal companion. The Master can empower you or restrict your will through their Grimoire.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.sit.desc.pet: §e'Stay' order:§f The Master ordered you not to move.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.tp.desc.pet: §eLoyalty:§f The Grimoire's magic will pull you to the Master if you fall behind.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.pacifist.desc.p: §ePacifism:§f The Master has forbidden you from harming anyone.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.nobreak.desc.pe: §eSoft Paws:§f The Master has forbidden you from breaking blocks.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.prot.desc.pet: §eBlood Guard:§f You see only the target the Master pointed out.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.aura.desc.pet: §eMerge:§f Your life energy slowly heals the Master.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.vampiric.desc.p: §eSacrifice:§f When dealing damage to enemies, you heal the Master.
gui.bondofthebeast.staff.absorb.desc.pet: §eAbsorption:§f The Master has sealed you in the Grimoire. You see the world through their eyes.
